profile.headline: Full-stack Engineer with interest in Software Development Management
profile.summary:
I am currently a .NET developer living in Northern Virginia. I have been working with the Microsoft technology stack since 2007 and have enjoyed software development as a whole. I intend on learning other languages and frameworks as well as staying up-to-date with current programming trends and best practices. Over the past several years, I've expanded my skills and have been engaged in other technical roles, such as DevOps and an SRE.

Outside of my professional life, I enjoy different outdoor sports, grilling, playing with our dog, and traveling with my family.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior .NET developer working on multiple projects (small to large) with emphasis on developing and maintaining backend/server-sided .NET applications driven by customer requirements and industry standards.

Spearhead communication and  troubleshoot processes  between the development team and other business units

Involved in all phases of SDLC, including requirements gathering, designing data models, and test planning
•	Experience in Waterfall, Agile Software Development, TDD (Test Driven Development)

Maintaining/improving a critical public facing, web-based platform to our business model that provides bankruptcy data in real time to users as well as provide other features such as workflow management, user onboarding, and other operational services
o	Currently serving over 2,500 users over 40 clients 

Contributing as a Site Reliability Engineer for triaging and diagnosing day-to-day issues and ad-hoc operational requests to maintain the stability of all systems and sites
o	Participating in a bigger department that is a cross collaboration between IT and DevOps

Developed automation tools and software suites that assist and streamline manual processing for clients and operations team through usages of Microsoft and open-sourced technologies

Engaging in AWS migration projects as well AWS certification training

positions.title: .NET Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop .NET web applications for Department of State using Microsoft .NET Framework (C#/VB) and SQL Server 2005/2008.

Self-managed, self-assertive developer. 

Experience with CMMI, agile development, and project planning.

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on web application built for Department of Defense to manage computer assets and report compliancy. Worked with .NET Framework, SQL Server 2005, SSIS, and web services (SOAP and WSDL)

educations.schoolName: The George Washington University School of Business
